title: Pre-Trained Language Models Represent Some Geographic Populations Better Than Others

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring and comparing the perplexity scores of pre-trained language models on comparable, geo-referenced English social media sub-corpora representing 927 local populations to evaluate goodness-of-fit across different regions.

Using regression analysis to test the correlation between a region's wealth (per capita GDP) or international connectedness (amount of air travel) and the language models' perplexity scores for that population.
